collider.dragHint: Drag the box to move it, its squares to resize, or draw a new one outside it.
collider.empty: The sprite has no opaque pixels
collider.fitHint: Around the opaque pixels of all frames (the feet for top-down)
collider.sliceNote: The box follows the slice frame by frame; edit it with the slice tool.
description: Map tags to a game character's states and directions, tune movement, transitions, collider and camera, and play it in a preview
directions.1: One direction (side views turn by mirroring)
export.hint: Use File → Export and pick "Game rig (zip)"
export.label: Game rig (zip)
hint.platformer: Click here: A D / ← →, Shift runs, W / Space jumps, J attack, H hurt, K death
hint.rts: Click to send the unit; J attack, K death
hint.topdown: Click here: WASD / arrows, Shift runs, J attack, H hurt, K death
movementHint.platformer: Side view with gravity, jumps and platforms.
movementHint.topdown: Moves freely with WASD in the directions you set.
name: Game rig
notLocked: The rig doesn't lock this sprite
problem.collider: The collider sticks out of the frame
settings.altHint: Hold (or press) the key and this state plays its alternative tags; directions without them play the usual ones.
settings.altNameHint: Also the word its tags are found by: Bomb finds IdleDownBomb
settings.autofillHint: Picks the closest tag for every state and direction: walk_left, WalkLeft, left-walk…
settings.compassHint: Click an arrow to pick a direction. A filled dot has a tag; a hollow one plays a stand-in (faded in the middle).
settings.createTagsHint: Adds new frames with a tag for every empty crossing
settings.keyHint: Click and press the key that switches the state on
settings.nothingToCreate: Every crossing already has a tag
settings.ownStateName: Name of the state (carries, swims, sneaks…)
settings.physicsHint: How quickly the character speeds up and stops; walking and running speeds are set in their states.
